outputs.question: how do i filter by jobs in manpower reporting

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Filter Manpower Reporting by Job
sources.guidance: Employees with business-write access can filter labor by Production Job. Open Reporting → Manpower Reporting, then choose the Job in Job labor review. Use Clear job filter or All reporting groups to reset. After selecting a Job, Product Category filter narrows products. Analytics use the selected reporting period; reporting rows are loaded complete groups with all their dates. Search and filters are not exhaustive until all available history is loaded. Read-only accounts cannot change the current Job labor review selector, but can use Search manpower or open a Job’s Current Hours link from Production.
sources.path: Reporting → Manpower Reporting → Job labor review

outputs.question: how do i initiate a rework for a job?

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Initiate Job Rework
sources.guidance: Authorized business writers can create Rework for a completed Production Job. Open the Job in Production and select Create Rework. Choose a Reason, describe Rework Scope / Work Required, enter Intake / Return Date, then select Create Rework. The Job must be complete, unarchived and have no active Rework cycle. Only one Rework cycle can be active at a time. Rework remains on the same canonical Job and preserves original Production status and dates. Scope is a whole-Job description, not structured piece or Color Plate tracking.
sources.path: Production → completed Job → Create Rework → Create Rework

outputs.question: How do I record an intake in Inventory?

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Record Inventory stock intake or outtake
sources.guidance: Employees with business-write access can record stock movements. Open Inventory → Current Inventory → Record Stock. Choose Intake or Outtake, enter Your Name and material lines with positive quantities, units and matching lot details, then Record Intake Lines or Record Outtake Lines. Intake adds to a matching lot or creates one; Outtake draws from matching lots and cannot exceed available matching stock. Each line updates Inventory immediately and creates an Activity transaction. For one lot, open its material group, select the lot, use Stock Movement, enter quantity and optional Reason / Note, then Record Intake or Record Outtake. Inventory Intake means a stock movement, not the Pre-Production Intake workspace.

outputs.question: How do I create a new Sample formula?

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Create and save a Sample formula
sources.guidance: Employees with operational access and business-write permission can build and save a working Sample formula without requiring a Production Job. Open Toolbox → Tools → Sample Form Generator and choose New Sample. Select a Resin System in Formulation setup, review and apply the configured profile when prompted, and complete the Sample and formulation details. Choose Save Sample; an existing draft uses Save Changes. Resolve resin-identity conflicts before saving. Suggested Color Plate numbers are assigned when saved; unusual or conflicting identifiers require review. Saving a draft does not generate a Sample Work Order.
sources.path: Toolbox → Tools → Sample Form Generator → New Sample → Save Sample
